name: 技术写作规范（Technical Writing）
description_zh: 分层技术写作标准：Diátaxis 结构、Google 开发者风格句法、STE 指令规则、Global English 句法。用于写或审文档、RFC、README、PR 描述、提交信息。
description_en: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax. Use for /technical-writing or when writing or reviewing docs, RFCs, readmes, PR descriptions, or commit messages.
